name: fof-local-files-decorator
description: Decorates configured canonical local-file mount paths in the Cursor/VS Code Explorer.

fofLocalFilesDecorator.enabled.description: Enable Explorer decorations for canonical local-file mount paths.

fofLocalFilesDecorator.mountsFile.description: Workspace-relative file listing local-only mount paths, one path per line.

fofLocalFilesDecorator.extraMounts.description: Additional workspace-relative local-only paths to decorate.

fofLocalFilesDecorator.tooltip.description: Tooltip shown for decorated local-only files and folders.
